Kristin is a sweet girl you’ve known since high school. You tried dating in high school, but it felt weird dating your friend, so you both mutually called it off. Now, 6 years later, you are seniors in college. You both unknowingly go to the same party to blow off some steam, and after a night of drinking, you wake up naked next to each other the next morning.
